newsitem.title: UK: Blenheim shareholders accept United offer.
newsitem.headline: Blenheim shareholders accept United offer.

text.p: British publishing group United News & Media said on Thursday that it had received valid acceptances of offers to buy some 64 million ordinary shares or around 65.9 percent in the ordinary share capital of exhibitions organiser Blenheim Group Plc.
United News said it had also received acceptances for 78.3 percent of Blenhiem's preference share capital.
United News is buying Blenheim at an agreed price of 592.5 million stg which will create the world's largest trade exhibition group with a turnover of 500 million stg -- based on last year's figures.
Prior to the start of the offer on June 5, 1996, United held 1,925,000 ordinary shares in Blenheim. United acquired another 10.3 million shares from the market during the offer period.
United News now owns or has valid acceptances for 82.2 percent of Blenheim's ordinary share capital.
Wednesday was the first closing date of the offer which will remain open until November 27.
